notes: Adds a task for the owner (assign "owner": assigned to them and ranked in My next task by the normal rules) or for the agent's own queue (assign "agent": tagged agent:<persona>, see create_task_agent.json). parent is optional and must be inside the token's subtree (default: the connection root; a whole-workspace connection without parent adds a top-level task); it may also be a task this agent created that the owner has not removed, even before the owner's client has added it. The task lands provisional: the owner sees "Added by <agent>, keep?" and keeps or removes it; until then it is visible and rankable but marked. title is at most limits.title (500), next_action limits.next_action (2000), notes limits.notes (8000) code points, none blank; estimate_minutes 1..1000000; priority "now", "next" (default) or "later"; hardDeadline and due are ms since epoch (0..253402300799999). The field is next_action, not action, because action names the call. An optional repeat makes it a repeating task (see create_task_repeat.json). Any other field (softTarget, tags, ...) is invalid_request. request_id makes a retry safe, as in v2.3.
